g.text: Small colored dots beside a node; multiple dots show memberships
D1, D2, D3: minimum directed steps from RPL11
All direct RPL11 edges: 0 incoming, 9 outgoing
Deeper mitochondrial hits retained at 4/20 or more
Node size and x/20 show neighborhood recurrence
Concentric rings show minimum downstream distance; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
